title: ランタイム選択 UI + state badge
user_role: PC・スマホから同じ環境を使う自分
entry_point: Repo Open modal / Workspace 設定 (runtime selector)、Header chip + Drawer badge (状態)
state_diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> SelectorClosed
    SelectorClosed --> SelectorOpen: Repo Open / WS 設定を開く
    SelectorOpen --> LxdAvailable: GET /api/runtimes (Incus あり)
    SelectorOpen --> LxdAbsent: GET /api/runtimes (Incus なし)
    LxdAbsent --> LxdAbsent: incus-container disabled + install tooltip
    LxdAvailable --> ConfirmChange: 開いてる WS の runtime を変更
    LxdAvailable --> Persisted: 新規 WS で runtime 選択 → PATCH 200
    ConfirmChange --> Persisted: Confirm → PATCH 200
    ConfirmChange --> LxdAvailable: Cancel
    Persisted --> Ready: badge=ready (host は即時)
    Persisted --> Stopped: badge=stopped (非host 未起動)
    Stopped --> Starting: attach で incus launch
    Starting --> Ready: Status ready (WS event)
    Starting --> Error: launch 失敗 (WS event)
    Ready --> Stopped: WS close
    Error --> Starting: 再試行
    Persisted --> PatchError: PATCH 失敗
    PatchError --> LxdAvailable: 元値に戻しインラインエラー

scenarios.description: runtime selector が host/incus-container を提示。Incus 不在時は incus-container を disabled + install tooltip

steps.expected: runtime-selector が表示され runtime-option-host が選択可

scenarios.description: header chip + drawer badge が runtime view (starting/ready/error) に追従

steps.action: host runtime の WS を開く
incus-container runtime view が starting→ready→error と変化 (WS event)
steps.expected: badge の data-runtime-state が同じ順に追従、error は error メッセージを surface
runtime-selector-error にインラインエラー、選択は元値に戻る

scenarios.description: Host login scope (host--0000) は runtime selector/chip を出さず host-scope-label で区別

steps.expected: host-scope-label が distinct ラベルで表示、runtime-selector / runtime-chip は不在

gui_gates: each AC (5-1/5-2/5-3) has a [AC-*]-tagged e2e test
